summary: Seattle, software engineer, strong interest in RISC-V architecture, advocates for systemic solutions to unemployment, supports legalizing and regulating all drugs, critical of government inefficiencies, emphasizes the importance of education and infrastructure for economic vitality, prefers community-oriented urban planning, values transparency and accountability in governance, believes in the necessity of a social safety net, supports open-source software and standards, critical of corporate monopolies, interested in automation and its impact on jobs, advocates for environmental sustainability, prefers public transportation improvements, and has a nuanced understanding of taxation and economic policy.
